summary: Phase 3 end-to-end validated. Backend smoke /app/backend/tests/phase3_smoke.py passes (enroll, recognition, 400 claim with 2/3 proofs, project submit+review, award, PDF, verify valid/revoked/not_found, invalidate evidence → dependent certificate revoked + eligibility lost). Phases 1-2 regression unchanged: pytest 34/34 (test_backend.py + test_phase2.py). Frontend Phase 3 flows verified end-to-end on preview URL: /pathways/P01 enroll shows pathway-enrolled + pathway-percent 0 %; after completing M09 via API, /pathways/P02 enroll shows recognized-module-C03-M09 'Acquis reconnu', pathway-recognized-summary '2 module(s) et 2 compétence(s) reconnus automatiquement', recognized-competency-comp-construire; /modules/M16/learn?etape=projet shows project-rubric and after title+description submit, submission appears with status 'En attente d'évaluation'; evaluator (evaluator@casa-academy.ci) at /evaluation sees the submission, grading all criteria at level 1 then clicking Valider yields grade-error 'Score insuffisant pour valider (33 % < 60 %)', then grading all level 3 (100 %) validates; learner /espace shows credential-progress-CERT-CONC '3/3 preuves', attainment-comp-construire-M16-project row, claim succeeds → credential-award-CERT-CONC + credential-download-CERT-CONC + verify link to /verifier/CODE; /verifier/CODE shows 'Certificat valide', /verifier/CASA-XXXX-0000 shows 'Aucun certificat ne correspond à ce code', /verifier form works lowercased input; admin (admin@casa-academy.ci) /admin lists admin-award-{code}, filling admin-reason + admin-revoke → /verifier/CODE shows 'Certificat révoqué' with revoked info 'date — motif'. Access control: /evaluation as plain learner displays 'réservée aux évaluateurs' message; GET /api/evaluation/submissions → 403; GET /api/admin/certificates → 403; GET /api/projects/submissions/{sid}/file by another learner → 403. Footer 'by Relais IT (www.relaisit.com)' present on /pathways/P02, /espace, /verifier, /admin, /evaluation. Mobile 390×844 /pathways/P02 and /espace: no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase3 code is clean: pathways_api.py / projects.py / certificates.py use async + Pydantic + proper 400/403/404 responses, exclude _id, and build eligibility server-side. verification_url is derived from PUBLIC_APP_URL env — good. Frontend components have exhaustive data-testid coverage. No action required.
Minor (carried from iter 2): auth.py brute-force lockout still identifies by request.client.host+email across pods — not fixed yet, outside Phase 3 scope.
